=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Each caller above seeds the base image from a mirror before building." (issue #7215, third gap)
  Expected change site: scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh, clarify_image_build, the prebuilt-pull success branch (lines 59-68).
  Evidence of absence: When the prebuilt pull succeeds (line 59), the function calls `sandbox_image.sh build` and returns the first non-empty image ID (lines 64-66). `sandbox_image.sh build` can fall back to an unseeded local `docker build` after a label mismatch (scripts/sandbox_image.sh:153-160); the local build hits Docker Hub for the Dockerfile's `FROM`. Because the pre-seed is only run on the fall-through path below line 74, a successful local fallback build bypasses the mirror pre-seed entirely. The regression test `test_isolated_run_preseeds_when_prebuilt_handoff_builds_locally` (tests/test_clarify_sandbox_base_image_preseed.py:674-720) only covers the failure case — its stub `sandbox_image.sh build` fails with 429 and the function falls through to pre-seed. There is no test that proves pre-seed runs when the local fallback build succeeds.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
